about: Pictures of the as-surveyed station map. plan.png and elevation.png are drawn from zones.json, fixtures.json and landmarks.json. Every wall_<module>_<wall>.png is an orthographic picture of one wall seen from the module axis, evenly lit, taken at the survey: the stowage units are at their registered positions, no loose item is in the station and the robot is away. A symbol covers each return inlet's opening (the pictures do not show an inlet's build). All coordinates are in the station frame of the map files (x forward, y starboard, z deck), in metres.

mapping.about: station coordinates of pixel (u, v) of the picture, u to the right and v down from the picture's top-left corner: horizontal = h0 + u * h_per_pixel, vertical = v0 + v * v_per_pixel

views.seen: from the overhead side, looking toward the deck
